主要内容: The U.S. Treasury’s CDFI Fund launched a funding round for the CDFI Rapid Response Program (CDFI RRP) in February 2021, allocating $1.25 billion to support CDFIs in addressing the economic impacts of the pandemic. The program, part of the American Rescue Plan, offers emergency grants, rental assistance, and credit support. Applications must be submitted by March 25, 2021, with a one-month window. Only certified CDFIs as of February 26, 2021, are eligible. Awards depend on funding availability. The CDFI Fund also opened FY 2021 applications for the CDFI Program and Native American CDFI Assistance Program. Applicants are encouraged to review the Notice of Funds Availability (NOFA) and attend webinars for guidance. The CDFI Fund has allocated over $3.9 billion to CDFIs and community development entities since 1994, including $61 billion in tax credits and $1.7 billion in bond guarantees through various programs.
